abstract: AIM: Malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma (MCT) is an uncommon complication. Preoperative diagnosis is difficult because of the lack of specific symptoms and signs indicating malignancy. Thus, we retrospectively analyzed the clinical characteristics of patients and the role of surgery in their management. MATERIAL AND METHODS: During a 9-year period (2002-2010), six patients with malignant transformation arising from ovarian MCT were treated at the Gynecologic Oncology Unit of Bakirkoy Woman and Children's Training and Research Hospital. A retrospective chart review and analysis of the patients' data were conducted. RESULTS: Malignant transformation arising from ovarian MCT accounted for 1.9% of all ovarian MCT (6/321). Three cases were stage IA and the other three were stage IC. Histologically, three of six cases had squamous cell carcinoma (50%), two had a carcinoid tumor (33%), and one had mucinous adenocarcinoma (17%). All patients underwent comprehensive surgical staging. Two patients received adjuvant chemotherapy and one received adjuvant chemoradiation. Five of six patients were observed for 16-104 months and no recurrence was detected. One patient with a carcinoid tumor in stage IC died of disease within 34 months following the surgery. CONCLUSION: Early detection of malignant transformation arising from MCT is mandatory for treating patients, but in most patients malignancy was detected intraoperatively. Surgical cytoreduction with a complete staging procedure and adjuvant treatment may be reasonable for stage IC. Additionally, prognosis is better when the tumor is completely excised and does not extend beyond the capsule.
abstract_ja: 目的：成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）の悪性転化は稀な合併症である。特異的な症状や徴候がないため術前診断は困難である。そこで、患者の臨床的特徴と、その管理における外科的治療の役割を後方視的に解析した。方法：2002年から2010年の9年間に、Bakirkoy Woman and Children's Training and Research Hospitalの婦人科腫瘍ユニットで、卵巣MCTから生じた悪性転化の患者6例を治療した。後方視的なカルテ確認と患者データの解析を実施した。結果：卵巣MCTの1.9%（6/321）が悪性転化によるものであった。3例は病期IA、他の3例は病期ICであった。組織学的には、6例中3例が扁平上皮癌（50%）、2例がカルチノイド腫瘍（33%）、1例が粘液性腺癌（17%）であった。全例が包括的な外科的病期分類を受けた。2例が補助化学療法、1例が補助化学放射線療法を受けた。6例中5例は16〜104か月観察され、再発は認めなかった。病期ICのカルチノイド腫瘍の1例は、手術後34か月以内に原病で死亡した。結論：MCTから生じる悪性転化の早期発見は治療のために必須であるが、大半の患者では悪性腫瘍が術中に発見されていた。包括的な病期分類を伴う外科的細胞減量術と補助治療は、病期ICに対して妥当かもしれない。さらに、腫瘍が完全に切除され被膜を越えて進展していない場合に予後は良好である。
